title: What are Forward Deployed Engineers, and why are they so in demand? (2025)
summary: This article explores the role of Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), a hybrid position combining software engineering with customer-facing responsibilities. It explains what FDEs do, why the role is increasingly sought after by companies like Palantir and startups, and how this model differs from traditional engineering roles.
problem_solved: Clarifies the emerging Forward Deployed Engineer role and explains why companies are increasingly demanding professionals in this hybrid position.
why_valuable: Provides clarity on a rapidly growing engineering role that bridges product development and customer success, helping engineers and companies understand modern technical career paths.
